title: SpaceX Stock (SPCX) Rises 3.6% on Reports of EchoStar Talks (Nov 3)
summary: SpaceX (SPCX) rose 3.62% to close at $141.31 on Nov 3 as financial media tied the gain to reported Boost Mobile talks with EchoStar.
body_markdown:
## Why SpaceX Stock Rose


Per[Invezz](https://invezz.com/news/2026/11/03/why-spacex-shares-are-rising-on-tuesday/) , SpaceX shares rose on Tuesday on reports that the company is exploring a deal with EchoStar to acquire Boost Mobile or gain access to its wireless network. Invezz noted that EchoStar shares rose 2.75% on Tuesday, adding to Monday's gain, and that neither SpaceX nor EchoStar has publicly confirmed an agreement.


The Washington Post first reported the talks on Monday, November 2. As reported by[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/article/spacex-weighs-boost-mobile-deal-in-push-for-starlink-phone-service-report-160901851.html) , the Post said Musk met EchoStar chairman Charlie Ergen in October, according to two people familiar with the negotiations, and that the talks could end with SpaceX buying Boost Mobile outright or gaining access to its network. Yahoo Finance also cited SpaceX CFO Bret Johnsen, who said on an earnings call that the goal is to "become a major mobile carrier ... in the United States."


According to[Light Reading](https://www.lightreading.com/satellite/spacex-eyes-back-door-to-mvno-via-boost-mobile-report) , AT&T, T-Mobile and Verizon all reiterated their opposition to giving SpaceX mobile virtual network operator (MVNO) terms on their latest earnings calls, while Boost Mobile ended the third quarter of 2026 with 7.38 million wireless customers.


## SPCX Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Invezz wrote that a Boost Mobile deal could give SpaceX an established customer base and a faster route into US wireless for its planned Starlink Mobile service.
- Per[Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/11/03/spacex-just-delivered-a-monster-quarter-but-the-st/) , SpaceX's third-quarter Starlink revenue grew 69% year over year to $5.2 billion, while its Super Intelligence segment revenue rose 830% to $7.6 billion.
- Motley Fool also reported consolidated operating income of $2.8 billion for the quarter, compared with an operating loss of $273 million a year earlier.


### Risks


- No agreement has been confirmed, and Boost leases its network from AT&T and T-Mobile, so those carriers may still need to approve a deal, per Yahoo Finance. Light Reading quoted Verizon CEO Dan Schulman saying "there are no back doors to any of our MVNO agreements."
- Motley Fool reported that up to 1.3 billion additional shares became eligible for sale after the third-quarter earnings announcement, as lockups from the June[IPO](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/what-is-an-ipo/) expire.
- SpaceX spent $19.6 billion on capital expenditures in the third quarter, more than its entire revenue for the quarter, and is turning to debt to buy GPUs, according to Motley Fool.
